info.name: Retrieves information of the organization configurations.

items.docs:
Read-only view of organization settings.

API Client needs the **Subscriptions > View subscription** permission.

Patches editable organization configurations.

API Client needs the **Subscriptions > Manage subscription** permission to change organization configurations.

info.name: Retrieves information on the entitlements for the organization.

items.docs:
Entitlements and add-ons are shown with sufficient permissions

To fetch the entitlements, API Client needs at least one permission.
To additionally fetch the add-ons and subscription details, API Client also needs the **Subscriptions > View subscription** permission.

info.name: Retrieves usage data for entitlements for the organization.

params.name: granularity
params.description: Data granularity (summary, hour, day, month). Defaults to summary.

params.name: since
params.description: Start date for usage data (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: to
params.description: End date for usage data (ISO 8601 format)

params.name: entitlementIds
params.description: Optional comma-separated entitlement IDs. Valid values: appAnalyticsStreamLimit, applicationObjects, internalUsers, externalUsers

params.name: aggregations
params.description: Optional comma-separated aggregation functions. Valid values: Total, Max, P95, P90

params.name: assetKeys
params.description: Optional comma-separated asset keys (GUIDs) to filter results

items.docs:
Filter by entitlement, date range, and aggregation.

API Client needs the **Subscriptions > View subscription** permission.
